arxiv-2102-11207.creator: Rivu Radiah, Ville Mäkelä, Sarah Prange, Sarah Delgado Rodriguez, Robin Piening, Yumeng Zhou, Kay Köhle, Ken Pfeuffer, Yomna Abdelrahman, Matthias Hoppe, Albrecht Schmidt, Florian Alt
arxiv-2102-11207.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Rivu Radiah, Ville Mäkelä, Sarah Prange, Sarah Delgado Rodriguez, Robin Piening, Yumeng Zhou, Kay Köhle, Ken Pfeuffer, Yomna Abdelrahman, Matthias Hoppe, Albrecht Schmidt, Florian Alt. Today, many consumers own head-mounted displays (HMDs), allowing them to participate in scientific studies from their homes using their own equipment.

arxiv-2205-11236.title: 2-d signature of images and texture classification
arxiv-2205-11236.creator: Sheng Zhang, Guang Lin, Samy Tindel
arxiv-2205-11236.description: Abstract . We introduce a proper notion of 2-dimensional signature for images. This object is inspired by the so-called rough paths theory, and it captures many essential features of a 2-dimensional object such as an image. It thus serves as a low-dimensional feature for pattern classification. Here we implement a simple procedure for texture classification.

arxiv-2304-05743.title: Frame Error Rate Prediction for Non-Stationary Wireless Vehicular Communication Links
arxiv-2304-05743.creator: Anja Dakić , Benjamin Rainer , Markus Hofer , Thomas Zemen
arxiv-2304-05743.description: Abstract Wireless vehicular communication will increase the safety of road users. The reliability of vehicular communication links is of high importance as links with low reliability may diminish the advantage of having situational traffic information. The goal of our investigation is to obtain a reliable coverage area for non-stationary vehicular scenarios.

arxiv-2305-04091.title: Plan-and-Solve Prompting: Improving Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought Reasoning by Large Language Models
arxiv-2305-04091.creator: Lei Wang Wanyu Xu Yihuai Lan Zhiqiang Hu Yunshi Lan, Roy Ka-Wei Lee Ee-Peng Lim
arxiv-2305-04091.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have recently been shown to deliver impressive performance in various NLP tasks. To tackle multi-step reasoning tasks, few-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting includes a few manually crafted step-by-step reasoning demonstrations which enable LLMs to explicitly generate reasoning steps and improve their reasoning task accuracy.

arxiv-2410-10503.title: Accelerated Convergent Motion Compensated Image Reconstruction
arxiv-2410-10503.creator: Claire Delplancke, Kris Thielemans, Senior Member, IEEE, Matthias J. Ehrhardt
arxiv-2410-10503.description: Abstract Motion correction aims to prevent motion artefacts which may be caused by respiration, heartbeat, or head movements for example. In a preliminary step, the measured data is divided in gates corresponding to motion states, and displacement maps from a reference state to each motion state are estimated.

arxiv-2504-21329.title: Drawing Reeb Graphs
arxiv-2504-21329.creator: Erin Chambers, Brittany Terese Fasy, Erfan Hosseini Sereshgi, Maarten Löffler
arxiv-2504-21329.description: Abstract Reeb graphs are simple topological descriptors with applications in many areas like topological data analysis and computational geometry. Despite their prevalence, visualization of Reeb graphs has received less attention. In this paper, we bridge an essential gap in the literature by exploring the complexity of drawing Reeb graphs.

pmc-10512567.title: Determinants of puerperal sepsis among post-partum mothers in Mekelle city public hospitals, Tigray, Ethiopia, 2021: a case control study
pmc-10512567.creator: Solomon Gebretsion Sahle, Solomon Weldemariam, Mihret-ab Mehari, Tomas Amare Abraha
pmc-10512567.description: BackgroundPuerperal sepsis is among the leading causes of preventable maternal death not only in developing countries but also in developed countries which is usually reported as the third or fourth common direct cause of maternal death. Although the prevalence of puerperal sepsis is low, it is the significant cause of maternal mortality, morbidities and other long-term complications like secondary infertility.

pmc-10721668.title: The importance of prognosis in geriatric patients attending the emergency department: a comparison between two common short geriatric assessment tools
pmc-10721668.creator: Agnese Di Prazza, Baldassare Canino, Mario Barbagallo, Nicola Veronese
pmc-10721668.description: BackgroundThe use of short geriatric tools in the emergency department (ED) is increasing, but the literature is still conflicting. The aim of this study is to compare the precision and the accuracy of two short geriatric assessment tools to predict mortality in a cohort of older patients attending the ED.

pmc-10737054.title: SOCIAL DETERMINANTS OF HEALTH AND AGING: DISPARITIES AND BARRIERS TO ORAL HEALTH CARE AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN ALABAMA
pmc-10737054.creator: Nathan Smith, Stacey Cofield, Raquel Mazer
pmc-10737054.description: Limited data exists on the oral health status of the older adult population of Alabama; improved surveillance programs are needed for estimations and planning. Aim: This study compares gender, racial, and economic differences in barriers to oral healthcare among older adults in Alabama.

pmc-11659243.title: Diagnostic value of the isoenzymatic index of lactate dehydrogenase in blood serum in a special process for training cadet pilots
pmc-11659243.creator: Zbigniew Wochyński, Ireneusz Majsterek, Joanna Gerszon, Radosław Wojtczak, Jacek Kabziński, Jan Błaszczyk, Krzysztof A. Sobiech, Ewa Jabłońska, Wioletta Ratajczak-Wrona
pmc-11659243.description: ObjectivesSpecial aerial gymnastics instruments (SAGI) are permanent elements of specialist training for cadet pilots. Appropriate physical activity and fitness are essential for performing the tasks of military pilots. Therefore, one of the main goals of cadet training is to develop adaptation to the extreme conditions of a military pilot’s work.

pmc-12784959.title: Human Cardiac Organoids: Advances and Prospects from Construction to Preclinical Drug Evaluation
pmc-12784959.creator: Meng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Sheng Yang, Yiru Niu, Yiling Ge, Zaozao Chen, Juan Zhang, Yuepu Pu, Zhongze Gu, Geyu Liang
pmc-12784959.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights What are the main findings? This review proposes an integrated research framework for human cardiac organoids (hCOs) encompassing construction technology, pathological modeling, and application evaluation, and summarizes three pathological model construction strategies: patient-specific, gene-edited, and microenvironment-modulated.hCOs demonstrate superior sensitivity and accuracy in predicting drug-induced cardiotoxicity compared to traditional models, particularly in early warning, metabolism-related safety evaluation, and personalized drug response assessment. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13596072.title: SemNet Explorer: An Evidence-Grounded Knowledge Graph–LLM Framework for Multi-Scale Mechanistic Reporting Across Biomedical Domains
pmc-13596072.creator: Xin He, David Camacho, Lama Moukheiber, Meghna Iyer, Benjamin Zhao, Christophe Ye, Batuhan Nursal, Xinyu Guo, Albert J. B. Lee, Cassie S. Mitchell
pmc-13596072.description: Background:Mechanistic reporting from large-scale biomedical knowledge graphs remains challenging, particularly when integrating structured graph evidence with large language model (LLM)–based explanation in a reproducible and auditable manner. Existing approaches either rely on manual synthesis of graph-derived results or generate unconstrained narratives that lack traceability to underlying evidence.

pmc-13655601.title: Host-Associated Distribution and Mycological Characteristics of Fusarium sambucinum Species Complex and Other Fusarium Species in Rice, Maize, and Weeds in Korea
pmc-13655601.creator: Eunji Jeong, Jeong-Ah Seo
pmc-13655601.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fusarium asiaticum and Fusarium graminearum, belonging to the Fusarium sambucinum species complex (FSAMSC), are primary causal agents of Fusarium head blight (FHB) and associated mycotoxin contamination in cereal crops worldwide. In this study, we performed a nationwide survey of Fusarium populations in rice, a staple crop in Korea, and examined the distribution of trichothecene genotypes and the mycological characteristics of dominant species.
